cross_organization: every query is scoped to organization_id, so another organization's payload is NOT FOUND rather than found-and-refused. A refusal that has to compare two values is a refusal somebody can forget to write.
the_order_that_matters: mismatch -> return NOTHING, and say why
why_no_bytes_at_all: returning bytes and reporting hash_verified:false beside them would put the caller in the position of noticing, and a caller that forgets has replayed evidence that changed underneath the row.
